notes.title: What's New In Chapter 2?
notes.content:
[p]I’m going to be posting devlogs from here on out! And what better way to kick these off than with a preview of what’s awaiting Badgersaw and his friends in Chapter 2![/p][p][/p][p][i]Wait, did someone say friends?[/i] [/p][p][/p][p]It seems Tantalum and Mr. L decided to ditch our Badgeriffic hero as soon as they got out of the cave![/p][p][/p][p]Don’t worry though, the three have found themselves trapped in another awkward predicament, and Badgersaw is taking it upon himself to set them all free in a (mostly) solo adventure.[/p][p][/p][p][i]All of the screenshots below are still very much Work In Progress and don't represent the final art![/i][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301900/fb2e64f7328e22dd10225f06a2995e35c7557c49.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This time around the heroes have found themselves arrested and placed in a sectioned off area in a secluded village, free to wander around and uncover its many secrets. We’ll see a little less combat and a lot more puzzle solving and dialogue as the three unravel more of the mystery.[/p][p][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301900/f941450b0bb78b72a7af28b4ee913c364f90c1b9.png"][/img][/p][h2]Play at your own pace[/h2][p]Finally out of the confines of that claustrophobic nightmare cave, Badgersaw will have access to a kitchen to restore his HP and a sofa to sleep on. No longer will you have to manage saves and rations, it’s almost as though you can enjoy the pleasures of domestic life![/p][p][/p][h2]Cook your own meals[/h2][p]Badgersaw doesn’t actually know how to cook, but he can slap a bunch of ingredients between bread and call it a sandwich. In a pinch, he can even eat that really spicy pepper without crying![/p][p][/p][h2]Fraternise with your captors[/h2][p]The gang were placed under arrest by a group of mysterious tall women who give off ambiguously evil vibes. Regardless, they don’t seem to have sharp claws or murderous intent, so why not get to know them a little? Do a couple of quests for them and they might even let you out…?[/p]

notes.title: Chapter 2 & The Future
notes.content:
[p]With the recent announcement of my next IP, [i]Goblin Shaman[/i], you might be wondering: what does this mean for [i]Badgersaw[/i]? Is Chapter 2 still coming?[/p][p]
The short answer is: yes. Chapter 2 is very much in progress. The full chapter flow was already designed during the development of Chapter 1, and a good chunk of the groundwork is in place. That said, there's still several months of solid work left to do, and I currently can't afford to focus on it full time. I have to be realistic about how dev time is spent, so while I'm excited to return to [i]Badgersaw[/i], a release won't be happening in the near future.

Chapter 1 didn’t get much traction at launch. As my first commercial release, it’s been a huge learning experience, and I’m proud of what I made. I believe the game has a future, it just needs a bit more time to find its audience.

In the meantime, I’m building that audience with [i]Goblin Shaman[/i] and other upcoming projects. By creating new titles with the same heart and personality, I hope to grow a stronger community that can support a return to [i]Badgersaw[/i] with all the love it deserves.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3803730/Goblin_Shaman/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]If you're a fan and want to see Chapter 2 sooner rather than later, the best thing you can do is share the game with friends, leave a review, or [url="https://discord.gg/U3SUXe9f2Z"]hop into the Discord[/url] and say hi. Every bit of support helps.[/p]

notes.title: NEXT FEST AND DEMO FAQ!
notes.content:
Hello Badger Battalion!

We have arrived on steam next fest, and after much wailing and gnashing of teeth, my Dev Stream is now up and running! Come hang out and have a laugh as I experience the game I made for the first time!*

And if you haven't already, the discord group is growing and you can join up!
[url=https://discord.gg/U3SUXe9f2Z]Discord Group[/url]

*It's my first time playing it with you guys.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301900/bdb2cb69733f422d31e0b31e7f4302222c551c2a.png[/img]

[h2]DEMO FAQ[/h2]

[b]What exactly is in the Demo?[/b]

The demo is the first few segments of chapter one, with an alternate gag ending if you make it to the end. It also contains two optional bosses and a post-game scorecard for those who like to get stuck in.

[b]Will save data be transferable from the Demo to the Full Game?[/b]

The answer is yes! You can select any save games you made during the demo (provided that save game was made during or after Next Fest) from the Load menu in the main game, you're basically getting the first portion of the game for free!

[b]How long will the Demo be available to play?[/b]

I plan on keeping the demo available until one month after the end of next fest, so until April 3rd, make sure to play it before then!

[b]Can I share my feedback?[/b]

I welcome your feedback, I have a whole section devoted to in in Discord!


Anyway guys, I hope you take this chance to blindly blaze along the brazen brigade of the Badgersaw, and hope you have fun doing so!

notes.title: Demo Updated!
notes.content:
Hey there Badger Brigaders!

The demo of The Adventures of Badgersaw has been updated, and now much better reflects what you can expect from the final game. Updates include new and updated artwork, type font & more dialogue options between the main characters. There's also a new inventory/status screen where you can check out item descriptions and skills.

If you haven't had the chance to play through the whole demo yet, or if you'd like to give it another go, now is the time!
